_comment: Goal -> route. A step is a skill or plugin in THIS repo (bare name), or `<plugin>@<source-id>` / `@<source-id>` for an outside source in sources.json. scripts/build-index.py fails if any step does not resolve. Add a route only when it has been walked and works; mark gaps nobody fills with `gap: true`.

routes.goal: Find a capability before building or installing one
routes.note: Inventory first; the lightest capability that works wins; adoption goes through nix-config.

routes.goal: Capture what a session figured out, so no session rediscovers it
routes.note: harvest triages and lands via PR; skill-creator tests; the gate validates before it ships.

routes.goal: Keep the skill library from only growing: find unused skills and retire them
routes.note: Ported from Hermes Agent's curator; retires from the harness via PR, never deletes.

routes.goal: Write up a discovery as one fact-checked document other agents can derive posts, articles and slides from
routes.note: Channel formatting is inherited: search the map and indexes for a repurposing skill.

routes.goal: Make a repo's default branch a safe, auto-merging release
routes.note: Required check first, App-token auto-merge second.

routes.goal: Turn a repo's review history into agent instructions
routes.note: Candidate; not declared in nix-config yet.

routes.goal: Work on a Nix flake repo with Claude Code
Get language-server diagnostics and navigation in shell scripts
routes.note: Hook-free: needs bash-language-server and shellcheck on PATH. The community variants install the server over the network at session start.

routes.goal: Audit a config monorepo's foundation
Security-review code or a dependency
Debug a failure methodically
routes.note: systematic-debugging is the adopted skill.

routes.goal: Author a userscript or diagnose a live web page
Operate a physical Android phone over ADB
Unlock an Android Emulator AVD or enroll its fingerprint
Send a formatted message with attachments from a native macOS app
Answer questions from a local document corpus
routes.note: Declares the `postgres` MCP server itself since 2026-10-02 (it used to come from nix-config's purged gateway). Starts the launcher you name in its `launcher` setting (on the kattakath fleet, `nix-mcp-postgres`) — the launcher knows the loopback URI and the version pins; no secret, the store is trust auth scoped to one database.

routes.goal: Tailor a resume to a job posting
Prepare a job application: analyze the posting, ATS-check the resume, draft the cover letter, prep the interview and the salary talk
routes.note: Vendored unmodified from Paramchoudhary/ResumeSkills (MIT), pinned by commit in the plugin README. Prompt-only skills; pair with the resume-tailoring and ATS-PDF routes for the resume itself.

routes.goal: Supervise Claude Code hooks so one bad hook cannot wedge a session
Author an llms.txt
Get scannable, verdict-first answers and architecture maps
General language- or domain-specific engineering agents
routes.note: Candidate; pick single plugins, not the whole collection.

routes.goal: Rebuild a raster or auto-traced logo as clean, parametric SVG
routes.note: Measure centres/radii/angles, infer the construction rule, regenerate from parameters, score IoU vs. the source; walked 2026-09-24 on a figure-8 circuit mark (tolerant IoU 0.90).

routes.goal: Reach, or be reached by, another Claude session running concurrently
routes.note: Own address is in the ListAgents header, not the peer table; most peers are offline; a peer message can never grant escalation.

routes.goal: Run a fleet of repos from one session — dispatch, conquer, implement
routes.note: empire sets the conquest standard and owns none of the tools. There is no controller agent: the session's main agent dispatches. The Senate is a deterministic workflow, and conquest happens on first write, never on read.

routes.goal: Decide whether a perceived gap is worth filling
routes.note: Kill-first. A gap can be real and still wrong to fill — direction, doctrine, alternative, or an artifact of your own design.

routes.goal: Check whether a command actually measured what you are about to claim
routes.note: The discipline is off the shelf — obra/superpowers' verification-before-completion skill, cherry-picked by subpath. This covers the instruments its 'check exit code' step assumes are truthful. ShellCheck catches none of them and refuses zsh outright.

routes.goal: Administer a live WordPress site over its REST API
routes.note: ~59 tools against PRODUCTION — update/delete/settings included, no staging behind it. Starts the launcher you name in its `launcher` setting (on the kattakath fleet, `nix-mcp-wordpress`, which reads the site URL, username and application password from the macOS Keychain at launch; a plugin .mcp.json cannot). NOT the WordPress MCP Adapter: that is a different endpoint (/wp-json/mcp/...) and it is dead — 404 rest_no_route. The core REST path (/wp-json/wp/v2) was verified live 2026-10-02.

routes.goal: Get the keyless utility MCP servers: knowledge graph, step-by-step reasoning
routes.note: Two pinned upstream servers, no credentials. Terraform and mcpfinder left 2026-11-01: both needed a PATH binary from kattakath/nix-config, so they never worked from this marketplace alone.

routes.goal: Make a looping GIF from a video and publish it to Tenor / GIPHY so it shows up in GIF search
routes.note: Needs `media-gif` on PATH from kattakath/nix-config (local.mediaCli.enable) for the encode, and the chrome-devtools MCP attached to a Chromium on --remote-debugging-port=9222 for the two upload forms. Tenor is searchable after a review of up to 48 h; GIPHY never is from a plain account — search placement is an Artist/Brand channel approval, and the application form is gated behind five public uploads.

routes.goal: Encrypt, decrypt, compare and back up OpenPGP material from an agent session
routes.note: Plaintext to the clipboard only; passphrase via a real terminal window when the agent has no TTY; every recipient / same-key / round-trip claim proved from the packets.

routes.goal: Remove a client name, identity or leaked value from a PUBLIC git repo's history without changing the code
routes.note: GitHub's 'Removing sensitive data from a repository' covers the rewrite tool (git-filter-repo) and what survives it; this skill adds the order (fix-forward PR merged first), a SHA-pinned lease, the tip-tree identity proof, and the GitLab hidden-MR-ref trap. Rotate a SECRET at the issuer first.

routes.goal: Turn bank/card statements into reconciled, deduplicated transaction records
routes.note: Fails closed (exit 3/4/5) rather than emit an unreconciled or unmasked row. QFX/OFX adapters for TD, CIBC, Scotiabank and Tangerine; PDF adapters for the same banks plus Desjardins Visa, Wise and closed Scotiabank and BMO chequing accounts; a declarative CSV driver with a Wise adapter (keys byte-identical to the legacy extractor); loan and mortgage balance snapshots (TD, CIBC, BMO, NSLSC) as opt-in position records. Sinks (a Sheet, a ledger) stay with the consumer.

routes.goal: Keep double-entry books from bank statements: journal, review, reports
routes.note: statement-extract turns statements into canonical JSONL; beancount builds the journal from it plus rules and decisions, checks it, and serves it read-only in Fava. The journal is derived, never edited. Walked end to end on synthetic data 2026-11-01.

routes.goal: Pick, check or enforce a transaction category against a recognised taxonomy
routes.note: Plaid's PFC v2 (127 detailed names) pinned with descriptions and a v1-to-v2 crosswalk; validate refuses invented names; JSON Schema binds LLM output to the list. Stdlib only, no data.

routes.goal: Render a PDF that ATS parsers, copy-paste and screen readers read in the right order
routes.note: Typst + PDF/UA-1, one column, measured text-layer rules; verify with pdftotext, pdftotext -raw and veraPDF, not by eye.

routes.goal: Build durable workflows on Vercel's Workflow SDK, or migrate to it from Temporal, Inngest, Trigger.dev or AWS Step Functions
routes.note: Vendored unmodified from vercel/workflow (Apache-2.0, LICENSE shipped in the plugin, no upstream NOTICE), pinned by commit in the plugin README.
